title: Okay
text: Okay. These candy pillows were just okay. They arrived compressed, but they never fully expanded. I followed the directions and put them in the dryer for a little while, but they still were misshapened. The material is soft. The construction is decent. I just found them to be underwhelming.

product_metadata.title: Ashler Home Deco Throw Pillows Sweet Shaped Accent Throw Pillow Covers Candies, Soft Velvet Insert Included Cushion for Couch Bed Living Room, Red, 15 x 15 & 23.5 x 6 Inches
features: UNIQUE SWEET DESIGN: The most unique throw pillow ever. We designed a Sweet shaped throw pillow to add an energetic vibe to your home.

SOFT AND VELVET SMOOTH: For the surface fabric, we used high-quality materials as well. They are top-grade skin and pet-friendly polyester material and made it feel just like velvet, but even more soft and smooth.

NICE MATCH TO YOUR HOME(DIFFERENT PLACES): SIZE: 15x15 & 23.5x6 Inches Throw Pillows. This is a great size for you to have in your daily life. A variety of colors are available for your decor ideas. Try setting it in your bedroom, living room, put it on your bed, your couch, and even your car.

EASY CARE&WASH: A throw pillowcase you can throw into your wash machine! Please use delicate cycle and cold water for machine wash, and delicate mode for dryer. The pillowcase is easy to separate from the insert.

AMAZING VERSATILITY: Our outstanding designers made this pillowcase applicable for multiple functions or activities. It can be used as a decorative pillowcase or as a decent but price affordable gift idea. The shape of the pillow is unique and adorable. It’s really hard to find another product just like this with high quality and great design.
